cars.generation: Original Peugeot 104 production-road sporting hatchback family
cars.specification_market: 1979 Peugeot 104 ZS2 base production-road reference in recognition 1696, stamped April 1, 1979. Base pages 1–5 supply only standard identification, body/layout and mechanics. Additional gearsets, alternative final drives, competition options, maximum permitted capacity and later Group B 226 are excluded. Displacement follows the original nominal 1361 cc; the modern factory history rounds to 1360 cc. No competition output, minimum weight, exact chassis registration, production total or measured road performance is inferred. The photo illustrates an earlier 1124 cc ZS road body, not exact ZS2 equipment.
cars.summary: The 104 ZS2 was Peugeot’s purpose-built Group 2 homologation special, rather than an ordinary 104 with cosmetic trim. Its enlarged engine, twin Solex carburettors and documented production recognition mark an early step in Peugeot’s sporting-hatchback history before the 205 GTI. One original 104 sporting family is admitted; other ZS engines, later gearboxes and competition evolutions do not add separate counts.

sources.notes: Actual manufacturer historical article read through the web reader; direct raw download returned 403 and was not bypassed. Supports the ZS2’s 1979 Group 2 homologation purpose, twin Solex carburettors and original 93-CV factory retrospective rating. Keeps earlier 1124 cc ZS and later 72/80-CV engines/five-speed distinct. The factory’s rounded 1360 cc differs from the original nominal 1361 cc in form 1696. Performance and weights from other references are not mixed into this record.

media.caption: 1977 Peugeot 104 1.1 ZS photographed by Kieran White at the 2022 NEC show.
